description: 20 enterprise detection queries migrated from Splunk SPL and Elastic (EQL/ES|QL/KQL) to OCI Log Analytics (OCL), validated against SOC Application Logs and Windows host event sources.

queries.title: Splunk: Encoded PowerShell Command Execution
queries.source_query: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Sysmon EventCode=1 Image="*\\powershell.exe" CommandLine="* -enc *" | stats count by host User CommandLine | sort -count
queries.converted_logan_ql: 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' and 'Event ID' = '1' and 'Process Name' like '*\powershell.exe' and 'Command Line' like '* -enc *' | stats count as count by 'Host Name', 'User Name', 'Command Line' | sort -count | head 100
queries.verification_criteria: Matches Sysmon process creation event with encoded PowerShell command line.

queries.title: Splunk: Threat IP Outbound Beaconing
queries.source_query: index=firewall action=blocked | stats count by src_ip dest_ip dest_port | sort -count | head 50
queries.converted_logan_ql: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and Action = 'blocked' | stats count as Blocks by 'Source IP', 'Destination IP', 'Destination Port' | sort -Blocks | head 50
queries.verification_criteria: Aggregates blocked connection attempts by source IP and destination socket.

queries.title: Splunk: Web Application Authentication Failure Burst
queries.source_query: index=soc sourcetype="SOC Application Logs" action=login_failed | stats count as failures by user, src_ip | where failures > 10 | sort -failures
queries.converted_logan_ql: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and Action = 'login_failed' | stats count as failures by 'User Name', 'Source IP' | where failures > 10 | sort -failures | head 100
queries.verification_criteria: Detects high-volume credential brute force attempts against web services.

queries.title: Splunk: SQL Injection Error Burst via UNION SELECT
queries.source_query: index=soc sourcetype="SOC Application Logs" status=500 uri="*UNION*SELECT*" | stats count by uri, src_ip | head 50
queries.converted_logan_ql: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Response Code' = 500 and 'Request URL' like '*UNION*SELECT*' | stats count as hits by 'Request URL', 'Source IP' | sort -hits | head 50
queries.verification_criteria: Identifies 500 error spikes triggered by explicit SQL injection syntax in URI.

queries.title: Splunk: Payment Gateway API Error Burst
queries.source_query: index=soc sourcetype="SOC Application Logs" service=payment_gateway status>=500 | stats count as errors by service, status | sort -errors
queries.converted_logan_ql: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Service Name' = 'payment_gateway' and 'Response Code' >= 500 | stats count as errors by 'Service Name', 'Response Code' | sort -errors | head 50
queries.verification_criteria: Flags backend transaction processing degradation or denial of service.

queries.title: Splunk: Kerberoasting RC4 Ticket Request Spike
queries.source_query: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security EventCode=4769 TicketEncryptionType=0x17 | stats count as requests by User, ServiceName | sort -requests
queries.converted_logan_ql: 'Log Source' = 'Windows Security Events' and 'Event ID' = '4769' and 'Ticket Encryption Type' = '0x17' | stats count as requests by 'Target User Name', 'Service Name' | sort -requests | head 100
queries.verification_criteria: Detects TGS-REQ requests using weak RC4-HMAC cipher for offline cracking.

queries.title: Splunk: AS-REP Roasting Pre-Authentication Disabled
queries.source_query: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security EventCode=4768 PreAuthType=0 | stats count by TargetUserName, IpAddress | sort -count
queries.converted_logan_ql: 'Log Source' = 'Windows Security Events' and 'Event ID' = '4768' and 'Pre-Authentication Type' = '0' | stats count as requests by 'Target User Name', 'Client IP Address' | sort -requests | head 100
queries.verification_criteria: Detects TGT requests against accounts with DONT_REQ_PREAUTH flag enabled.

queries.title: Splunk: Active Directory DCSync Replication Abuse
queries.source_query: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security EventCode=4662 AccessMask="0x100" | stats count by SubjectUserName, ObjectName | sort -count
queries.converted_logan_ql: 'Log Source' = 'Windows Security Events' and 'Event ID' = '4662' and 'Access Mask' = '0x100' | stats count as Replications by 'Subject User Name', 'Object Name' | sort -Replications | head 50
queries.verification_criteria: Identifies non-machine accounts executing Directory-Replication-Get-Changes requests.

queries.title: Splunk: LSASS Memory Dumping via Process Access
queries.source_query: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Sysmon EventCode=10 TargetImage="*\\lsass.exe" GrantedAccess="0x1FFFFF" | stats count by SourceImage, TargetImage | head 25
queries.converted_logan_ql: 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' and 'Event ID' = '10' and 'Target Process Name' like '*\lsass.exe' and 'Granted Access' = '0x1FFFFF' | stats count as Accesses by 'Source Process Name', 'Target Process Name' | sort -Accesses | head 25
queries.verification_criteria: Detects suspicious process handle opening LSASS with full memory read access.

queries.title: Splunk: Administrative Role Assignment via API
queries.source_query: index=soc sourcetype="SOC Application Logs" action="grant_role" role="admin" | stats count by user, target_user, src_ip | sort -count
queries.converted_logan_ql: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and Action = 'grant_role' and Role = 'admin' | stats count as Grants by 'User Name', 'Target User Name', 'Source IP' | sort -Grants | head 50
queries.verification_criteria: Audits administrative role elevation events in cloud application audit records.

queries.title: Elastic Lucene: Encoded PowerShell Command
queries.source_query: event.code:1 AND process.name:powershell.exe AND process.command_line:(*enc* OR *EncodedCommand*)
queries.converted_logan_ql: 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' and 'Event ID' = '1' and 'Process Name' like '*powershell.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*enc*' or 'Command Line' like '*EncodedCommand*') | head 100
queries.verification_criteria: Maps ECS process fields to OCI display fields with wildcard disjunction.

queries.title: Elastic Kuery: HTTP POST 403 Forbidden Access Spike
queries.source_query: http.response.status_code:403 and http.request.method:post
queries.converted_logan_ql: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Response Code' = 403 and 'Request Method' = 'POST' | stats count as hits by 'Service Name', 'Trace ID', 'Source IP' | sort -hits | head 100
queries.verification_criteria: Aggregates forbidden POST submissions by service namespace and source IP.

queries.title: Elastic ES|QL: Application Error Hotspot Summary
queries.source_query: FROM logs-apm* | WHERE http.response.status_code >= 500 and service.name is not null | STATS errors = count(*) BY service.name | SORT errors DESC | LIMIT 20
queries.converted_logan_ql: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Response Code' >= 500 and 'Service Name' is not null | stats count as errors by 'Service Name' | sort -errors | head 20
queries.verification_criteria: ES|QL pipeline conversion aggregating 5xx errors by microservice component.

queries.title: Elastic TOML: Failed Authentication Threshold Alert
queries.source_query:
[rule]
type = "threshold"
language = "kuery"
query = '''event.category:authentication and event.outcome:failure'''
[rule.threshold]
field = ["source.ip", "user.name"]
value = 5
queries.converted_logan_ql: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Original Log Content' like '*authentication*' and Status = 'failure' | stats count as event_count by 'Source IP', 'User Name' | where event_count >= 5 | head 100
queries.verification_criteria: Threshold alert rule generating saved-search aggregation with post-filter.

queries.title: Elastic ES|QL: Multiple Failed Logins by Client IP
queries.source_query: FROM logs-auth* | WHERE event.action == "user_login" and event.outcome == "failure" | STATS fail_count = count(*) BY source.ip, user.name | SORT fail_count DESC | LIMIT 25
queries.converted_logan_ql: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Event Type' = 'user_login' and Status = 'failure' | stats count as fail_count by 'Source IP', 'User Name' | sort -fail_count | head 25
queries.verification_criteria: ES|QL aggregation detecting brute force credentials per host and identity.

queries.title: Elastic EQL: System Reconnaissance Command Discovery
queries.source_query: process where event.type == "start" and process.name in ("whoami.exe", "net.exe", "ipconfig.exe", "nltest.exe")
queries.converted_logan_ql: 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' and 'Event ID' = '1' and 'Process Name' in ('whoami.exe', 'net.exe', 'ipconfig.exe', 'nltest.exe') | stats count as Invocations by 'Process Name', 'Host Name', 'User Name' | sort -Invocations | head 50
queries.verification_criteria: Detects native Windows administrative commands commonly used for host discovery.

queries.title: Elastic ES|QL: API Latency Outlier Identification
queries.source_query: FROM logs-application* | WHERE http.response.status_code == 200 and duration_ms > 2000 | STATS avg_duration = avg(duration_ms), count = count(*) BY url.path | SORT avg_duration DESC | LIMIT 10
queries.converted_logan_ql: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Response Code' = 200 and 'Duration (ms)' > 2000 | stats avg('Duration (ms)') as avg_duration, count as count by 'Request URL' | sort -avg_duration | head 10
queries.verification_criteria: Identifies slow API endpoints exceeding normal service level objectives.

queries.title: Elastic Kuery: AD CS Certificate SAN Impersonation (ESC1)
queries.source_query: event.code:4887 and certificate.subject_alt_name:*
queries.converted_logan_ql: 'Log Source' = 'Windows Security Events' and 'Event ID' = '4887' and 'Subject Alternative Name' is not null | stats count as Issuances by 'Requester Name', 'Subject Alternative Name', 'Template Name' | sort -Issuances | head 50
queries.verification_criteria: Detects issued certificates containing custom Subject Alternative Names (SAN).

queries.title: Elastic ES|QL: Payment Amount Manipulation Anomaly
queries.source_query: FROM logs-payments* | WHERE transaction.amount > 10000 and transaction.status == "rejected" | STATS total_rejected = sum(transaction.amount), count = count(*) BY merchant.id | SORT total_rejected DESC | LIMIT 15
queries.converted_logan_ql: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and Amount > 10000 and Status = 'rejected' | stats sum(Amount) as total_rejected, count as count by 'Merchant ID' | sort -total_rejected | head 15
queries.verification_criteria: Detects abnormal high-value rejected transactions suggesting fraud attempts.

queries.title: Elastic EQL: Lateral Movement via Remote WMI Execution
queries.source_query: process where process.parent.name == "wmiprvse.exe" and process.name in ("cmd.exe", "powershell.exe")
queries.converted_logan_ql: 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' and 'Event ID' = '1' and 'Parent Process Name' like '*\wmiprvse.exe' and 'Process Name' in ('cmd.exe', 'powershell.exe') | stats count as Executions by 'Host Name', 'Command Line', 'User Name' | sort -Executions | head 50
queries.verification_criteria: Catches shells spawned as children of WMI Provider Host from remote commands.
